All Creatures Great and Small Provides food, care, medical treatment and rehabilitation to the sick, old, abandoned animals on streets Bronze Certified 2023 FCRA 80G 12A Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Is this your profile? Edit now . Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US Social --> Cause Area Primary Sectors Animal & Wildlife Health Food & Nutrition Financials 2021 Total Income Rs. 43,049,007 Total Expenses Rs. 40,150,364 Non Program Expenses Rs. 11,062,052 Program Expenses Rs. 29,088,312 Tip: Click on any value above to exclude it. 2022 Total Income Rs. 33,082,790 Total Expenses Rs. 30,610,674 Non Program Expenses Rs. 9,677,965 Program Expenses Rs. 20,932,709 Tip: Click on any value above to exclude it. 2023 Total Income Rs. 24,228,777 Total Expenses Rs. 19,973,151 Tip: Click on any value above to exclude it. Geographies Served Programs The Sanctuary State Delhi States Delhi The majority of animals, including roosters, geese, turkeys, rabbits, dogs, cats, emus, goats, cows, horses, buffaloes, mules, donkeys, and ducks, are rescued. They are too young and orphaned to survive on the streets on their own, or they are old, ill, and damaged. They have either healed or are in the process of healing. But none of them can take care of themselves if they ever have to live on the streets again. Although we don't always find homes for them, we keep trying, and occasionally it works. In the future, we hope to improve our adoption programme. Their physical needs are continuously being met by our medical staff and visiting veterinarians. The Clinic State Delhi States Delhi The clinic at ACGS is adequately furnished to manage common medical issues, such as minor surgeries, wound care, immunisations, amputations, and sterilisations. In addition to treating outpatients who come in from the nearby villages, the clinic also takes care of the medical needs of the resident animals. Milestones & Track Record Established an animal shelter in Haryana in 2012 that now houses over 400 rescued animals. --> --> Leadership Team Rishi Harsana Veterinary Asst. Ram Singh Horticulture Asst.
